outcome: Incidence of abnormal placentation (placenta accreta, increta, percreta) in emergency peripartum hysterectomy specimens
cohort: 18 women who underwent emergency peripartum hysterectomy due to abnormal placentation over an 8-year period
finding: Among abnormal placentation, placenta accreta was the most common (55.5%), and it was more common in multiparous women; previous cesarean section was the most commonly associated risk factor, followed by placenta previa and pre-eclampsia.
